title: Clarify locale-safe DateFormula Evaluate inputs
summary: Adds a Microsoft Style article clarifying that DateFormula Evaluate calls require language-independent literals to work correctly in non-English localizations, addressing a localization gap where such calls could fail despite correct downstream CalcDate typing.
key_points: New Style article: Evaluate into a DateFormula with a literal like '1W' can fail outside English
Paired bad/good scheduling samples show the issue and the invariant-input fix
Style review skill gets narrow routing to the article, plus a new positive/clean evaluation pair
Direct CalcDate diagnostics remain owned by the analyzer (AA0462)
Frontmatter and index checks passed; runtime locale tests were not executed
